stones.label: High Pilings Above Dry Terrain
stones.causal_role: Zenobia stands on very high pilings of varying heights over cracked, dry ochre mesa ground with zero marsh, tide, or floodwater below.

stones.label: Houses of Bamboo and Oxidized Zinc
stones.causal_role: Light superstructures framed in golden split bamboo and corrugated oxidized-zinc sheets perched upon multi-tier stilts.

stones.label: Platforms and Balconies Crossing on Stilts
stones.causal_role: Cantilevered decks and balconies at staggered altitudes overstepping and crossing one another in open sky.

stones.label: Ladders and Swaying Hanging Sidewalks
stones.causal_role: Vertical bamboo rung-ladders and catenary rope-and-plank catwalks linking stilted platforms across airy chasms.

stones.label: Cone-Roofed Belvederes
stones.causal_role: Conical zinc-and-bamboo belvedere pavilions crowning the highest stilts as windward lookouts.

stones.label: Elevated Barrels of Water Storage
stones.causal_role: Hooped timber-and-zinc cistern barrels hoisted onto upper platforms to hold precious water high above the arid plateau.

stones.label: Pulleys, Fish Poles, and Projecting Cranes
stones.causal_role: Rigged sheave pulleys, jib cranes, and long cantilevered bamboo fishing poles casting lines and baskets into dry air.

stones.label: Spinning Weathervanes and Fluttering Ribbons
stones.causal_role: Finial zinc weathervanes and silk ribbons streaming horizontally in the high plateau wind.

stones.label: Unremembered Motive of the Founders
stones.causal_role: Probing the baked mesa post-sockets reveals dry dust and zero flood-history; nobody remembers why the founders raised Zenobia on stilts.

stones.label: Happy-Life Recombination & Desire-Form Taxonomy
stones.causal_role: Asked to imagine a happy life, any inhabitant or visitor inevitably recombines Zenobia's pilings, stairways, and hanging balconies—placing Zenobia among cities that give form to desires rather than cities erased by them.

calvino_source.inner_arch: Though nobody remembers why the founders raised Zenobia on high pilings above dry ground, anyone asked to describe a happy life can only imagine a city like Zenobia—recombining its pilings, ladders, and hanging balconies into airier permutations—placing Zenobia not in a happy/unhappy binary, but among cities that continue through years and changes to give form to desires.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive multi-altitude bamboo-and-zinc stilt trusswork loom over dry ochre mesa coupled to a generative Happy-Life Desire Recombinator that sublimates every attempt at flat-ground founding into higher, more intricate stilted catwalk permutations, with procedural wind-creak/bamboo-chime WebAudio and Royal Plate Guild copperplate cartography (map.png / map.svg) and architectural plate (image.png).
anti_trude_vector.typography: Self-contained system humanist/engraved serif ('Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Georgia, serif) paired with crisp drafting monospace ('SF Mono', 'Menlo', monospace); zero external font CDNs.

stilted_trusswork_methods: createTrusswork(config) -> { getState, setViewport, step, render, inspectAt, probeMesaFooting, elevateCluster, spanCatwalk, hoistBarrels, triggerGust, applyDreamPermutation, setReducedMotion, setMuted, toggleMute, isMuted, playSound, reset, destroy }
happy_life_dreamer_methods: createDreamer(config) -> { getState, dreamFromPrompt, attemptGroundReset, setDesireAxis, recombineNext, getCurrentPermutation, getHistory, renderDreamSketch, reset }

invariants.dry_ground_law: The ground horizon (y >= mesaY) is strictly arid cracked ochre/sienna clay (`groundMoisture === 0`, `waterAtGround === false`); all water resides exclusively in elevated barrels on upper platforms (`barrelCount >= 6`).
invariants.inevitable_elevation_law: Calling `attemptGroundReset()` or dreaming a flat/earthbound town (`dreamFromPrompt('flat_courtyard')`) momentarily sketches flat blocks and immediately sublimates them (`flatAttemptSublimated === true`), raising `meanAltitudeMeters` above baseline and generating new crossed catwalks, ladders, cone belvederes, pulleys, fish poles, weathervanes, and ribbons (`classification === 'gives_form_to_desires'`).

zenobia-piling-joiner.epistemic_partition: Builds the multi-altitude bamboo-and-zinc stilt architecture over dry cracked mesa: pilings, crossing platforms/balconies, ladders, hanging catwalks, cone-roofed belvederes, hoisted water barrels, pulleys, cranes, fish poles, spinning weathervanes, silk ribbons, dry-footing founder-enigma probe, and procedural wind-creak/bamboo-chime WebAudio.

zenobia-recombiner.epistemic_partition: Builds the Happy-Life Desire Recombinator & Taxonomy engine: models 6 desire prompts including attempts to build from scratch on flat ground, proves every dream of happiness inevitably re-synthesizes and elevates Zenobia's pilings and catwalks into higher airier permutations, and encodes Calvino's desire-form taxonomy.

zenobia-weaver.epistemic_partition: Splices both layers inline into standalone index.html using bespoke <zenobia-stilt-loom>, <dry-mesa-pilings>, <hanging-catwalk-rig>, <happiness-recombinator>, and <zenobia-plate-drawer> [P] custom DOM, responsive at 1280x800 and 390x844, zero external URLs or ../ refs, J_dom < 0.35.

zenobia-critic.epistemic_partition: Blindfolded verifier auditing HG-1..HG-4, verify_trude.py standalone/J_dom checks, Playwright 1280x800 + 390x844 + reduced-motion runtime checks, and Royal Plate Guild map.png + map.svg + image.png verification on disk.

hard_gates.HG-1: Standalone & Anti-Trude Morphology: zero http(s):// or // URLs, zero ../ cross-city refs, custom DOM (<zenobia-stilt-loom>, <dry-mesa-pilings>, <hanging-catwalk-rig>, <happiness-recombinator>, <zenobia-plate-drawer>), .zenobia-* CSS, J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-2: Stones & Dry-Mesa Stilt Physics: high pilings over strictly dry cracked mesa (`groundMoisture === 0`), bamboo/zinc houses, crossing balconies, ladders, swaying hanging sidewalks, cone-roofed belvederes, elevated water barrels, pulleys, cranes, fish poles, weathervanes, ribbons, unremembered founder footing probe, and wind-creak/bamboo-chime WebAudio.
hard_gates.HG-3: Inner Arch Desire Recombination: attempting to dream a happy life from scratch (even choosing flat ground) inevitably rejects flatness (`flatAttemptSublimated === true`) and elevates/recombines Zenobia's pilings and catwalks into higher, airier permutations under the 'gives_form_to_desires' classification.
hard_gates.HG-4: Viewport, Accessibility & Royal Plates: zero overflow/errors at 1280x800 and 390x844, keyboard + prefers-reduced-motion support, and inspectable <zenobia-plate-drawer> [P] verified against Royal Plate Guild map.png (1600x1200), map.svg, and image.png (1600x1000) on disk.
